446817.overview: Years after the horde have claimed Earth's surface, they find their way into Bunker 4103 - the last bastion of humanity. You awake in a remote part of the underground shelter, and if you want to remain human you must reach the bunker's deepest point: the safe room.

448168.overview: Jump, Roll, Hop and Dive your way through sharp caves to rescue your friends.

448594.overview:
Rocket to the Top is a flight simulator game.

You’re Jet Cat, a rookie cat pilot in the M30-W fleet. You’ve been dispatched to an uncharted planet to investigate the surface’s potential for life. Near the end of your mission, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious tower, filled with floating coins and cursed rubies! Do you have what it takes to master your ship’s challenging controls, navigate the tight corridors, escape to the top of the tower, and return home with the treasure?

448696.overview:
This is a tiny puzzle game, where you solve most problems by pushing rocks. No pulling the rocks, please!

It is possible to skip to any level, by entering a level code in the tutorial screen:

    What Rock? → ↑ → →
    The Pushing Begins ↓ ↓ ↑ →
    Osmosis ← → ↓ →
    Touchdown ↑ ↓ ↓ ↑
    A Big Hug ↓ ← ↑ ←
    Make Way ↑ ↓ → ↓
    Attack Dog ↑ → ↑ ↑
    Hit Man ← ↑ → ↑
    Treat Yourself ↑ → ↓ →
    Columns ← ↓ ↑ ←

448857.overview:
A game about becoming beautiful.

You are but a wee skeleton residing in the Necromancer's Tower. You realize that your skull would be so much prettier if you had some rubies where your eyes would be. Rumor has it that the necromancer holds some very impressive gems. Maybe you should go take a look?

451240.overview:
A mixture of two genres – a Roguelike and a Tetris-style game – based on a prototype I made with a friend (@ollie_read) in 8 hours during a "Crafts and Gin" Game Jam back in 2012.

• 10 levels
• Procedural generation
• Musicality!
• Old-school gameplay
• But actually winnable though

Arrow keys to move/rotate/drop blocks, X + arrows to move rogue and fight monsters.

Full instructions can be found in game. I hope you enjoy it.

451359.overview: PICO-8 port of Irem's R-Type featuring 4 stages, 30 enemies with most attack patterns and weapons replicated (albeit simplified), 3 HUGE bosses, 3 force types with 2 levels of power, 60 fps action with arcade-style graphics, and an awesome soundtrack with 5 tracks by the great Damien Hostin (YouryKiki) based on Masato Ishizaki's original score.

452893.overview:
Jump, climb and punch your way through as many cities as you can before the army hunts you down!

Some say it was radiation, some a weird virus, but the only sure thing is that James, Linda and Richard turned into huge kaijus with a single goal in mind: to destroy as much as possible before turning back to humans!

Play as James the Ape, Linda the Lizard and Richard the Wolf as they travel through the capital cities of every country rampaging through the whole world! Destroy all buildings, eat people and survive as much as possible before the army stops you!

A game inspired by classic arcades for one or two players. 

Rampage for Pico-8.

453477.overview:
A River Raid heavily inspired game.

Shot on enemies and avoid hitting the ground on this classic inspiring gameplay.
Run for your highscore at an infinity loop map.
